request.subject: UNIT:MARTIAN:SUBMARINE

layers.text: Turn it into a chrome bathysphere submarine: the long hull becomes one round ball-shaped hull of the same polished chrome with a dark gunmetal underside; remove the tall antenna mast; a big clear glass dome on top, one large round glass porthole on the side, two small fins, a short antenna with a glowing hot magenta tip, and a row of small glowing hot magenta lights around its middle. Keep the size, waterline, thick black outline and style, with nothing under the hull.
